summary: Relive the keynote from AWS Cloud & AI Day Kuala Lumpur 2026, November 4, Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre. Hear from AWS leaders on agentic AI and empowering builders, plus the launch of Semarak AI Malaysia and customer success stories. Discover how AWS equips builders with the tools to push the boundaries of what’s achievable, from agentic AI and data analytics to cloud migration and modern application development. Featuring: • YB Datuk Seri Johari Abdul Ghani, Minister of Investment, Trade and Industry • Hussein Mohd Ali, Country Manager, Malaysia, Pakistan & Brunei, AWS • Nam Je Cho, Director, Technology APJC, AWS • Albern Murty, Chief Executive Officer, CelcomDigi • Vashta Mahendran, Group Chief Operations Officer, RHB Banking Group Learn more about AWS events: https://go.aws/events Subscribe: More AWS videos: http://bit.ly/2O3zS75 More AWS events videos: http://bit.ly/316g9t4 ABOUT AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) hosts events, both online and in-person, bringing the cloud computing community together to connect, collaborate, and learn from AWS experts. summary: In Episode 1 of The Round Up presented by AWS, Sky Sports’ Iona Stephen joins leaders from AWS, BMW and the DP World Tour to explore how the Tour’s migration to AWS is unlocking new opportunities for innovation across the sport. With its technology infrastructure now running on AWS, the DP World Tour is leveraging cloud technology, AI and data analytics to modernize operations, enhance the fan experience and transform how golf connects with audiences worldwide. Learn more at aws.com/golf.
